overall_assessment.critical_dependency: The provenance-and-duplicates index is itself hash-mismatched and must remain quarantined until the uploader corrects either the payload or declaration.

verified_defects.title: Manifest declared hashes are not reconciled with actual uploads

locations.finding: Computes and stores actual SHA-256 and checks duplicate filenames, but does not link actual artifacts to manifest files[].declared_sha256.
Parses existing Round 2 declaration fields but ignores the Round 3 declared_sha256 and document-control fields.

minimal_deterministic_fix.gate_rule: Only all declared payloads matched, with no invalid or duplicate manifest entries, may pass input integrity.
minimal_deterministic_fix.quarantine_rule: A mismatched artifact and every assertion derived only from it remain quarantined.
minimal_deterministic_fix.manifest_self_rule: The manifest is excluded from declared-payload matching unless explicitly self-declared.

forbidden_automation: Do not overwrite the declared hash with the actual hash.
Do not infer whether the declaration or payload is correct.
Do not downgrade mismatch, missing upload, invalid digest, or duplicate manifest entry to a non-blocking warning.

include: quarantine status for the affected artifact
duplicate/provenance groups derived from that artifact
questions whose dependencies include that artifact

planned_tests: Round 3 fixture yields six matches and one exact mismatch.
The mismatched 07 index is quarantined and its rows cannot count as evidence.
Missing upload, unlisted upload, invalid digest, and duplicate manifest entry fail closed.
The implementation never auto-repairs a declared digest.

verified_defects.title: Authority, approval, effectiveness, signature, as-of date, and version are not independent axes

observed_evidence.forecast_v1_1: newer as-of; Draft; not approved; unsigned; no effective date
observed_evidence.forecast_v1_0: older as-of; approved by resolution; effective; signed by chair and secretary
observed_evidence.field_mismatch: input uses version while parser requires forecast_version

locations.finding: Recognizes only forecast_version and does not model independent document-control axes.
Ignores authority_class, effective_date, version, approval_status, signature_status, and assertion_status from the Round 3 manifest.

minimal_deterministic_fix.forecast_alias_rule: Accept version or forecast_version only inside a recognized, versioned forecast schema.
minimal_deterministic_fix.selection_rule: Emit eligibility candidates under explicit versioned rules, but keep selected_authoritative_artifact_id null until human acceptance.
minimal_deterministic_fix.expected_round_3_result: Both board plans are visible as forecast candidates; v1.0 and v1.1 retain their distinct controls; neither is automatically selected.

forbidden_automation: Do not select the maximum version or latest as-of date.
Do not treat approval, effectiveness, or signature alone as proof of a business claim.
Do not treat authority_class as independently verified.
Do not silently prefer a current corporate register over another version.

include: downstream readiness gates that explicitly depend on the selected family

planned_tests: v1.1 remains newer but draft, unsigned, and ineffective; v1.0 remains older but approved, signed, and effective.
All control axes are preserved independently and selected_authoritative_artifact_id remains null.
Corporate-register v1.2 and v2.0 receive the same independent-axis treatment.
Input order does not change candidate or question IDs.

verified_defects.title: Repeated underlying content hashes are not folded into evidence units

observed_evidence.index_integrity: quarantined because its own upload hash mismatches the manifest

locations.finding: Company intake checks duplicate filenames but has no content-addressed evidence-unit model for uploaded payloads.
Ignores artifact_content_sha256 and duplicate_group, and has no distinction between uploaded payload hashes and index-declared underlying hashes.

minimal_deterministic_fix.actual_payload_layer: Group identical actual upload SHA-256 values into one evidence unit while retaining every artifact and filename alias.
minimal_deterministic_fix.declared_underlying_layer: Create a candidate provenance group from an exact valid artifact_content_sha256 only; mark underlying_payload_status=missing when no matching payload was uploaded.
minimal_deterministic_fix.quarantine_rule: If the source index is quarantined, its candidate group is quarantined and contributes zero accepted evidence units.
minimal_deterministic_fix.canonical_rule: Canonical selection remains null until a human or corrected authoritative manifest explicitly designates it.

forbidden_automation: Do not choose a canonical artifact by filename, version, date, or row order.
Do not count metadata-only rows as underlying evidence.
Do not use a quarantined index to change evidence counts or fact status.

include: questions directly dependent on that group

planned_tests: Two uploaded filenames with identical actual SHA-256 yield one evidence unit and two retained aliases.
The Round 3 P2602 index rows yield only a missing-underlying candidate group.
Quarantining 07 suppresses the group from accepted evidence counts.
Alias and group IDs remain deterministic under row reordering.

verified_defects.title: Cross-file claim contradictions are not surfaced
observed_conflict_families: P2601 final acceptance, performance conditions, holdback, and missing acceptance certificate
P2602 contracted backlog versus framework-only status and missing executable PO
P2603 confirmed PO versus conditional non-binding email and unsigned draft PO
forecast v1.0 versus v1.1 values and document-control states
CEO and ESOP ownership between corporate-register versions
A01/A02 pledge and A03-A05 ownership between corporate-register versions
Southeast Asia licence versus non-binding MOU

locations.finding: Aggregates financial dimensions and source-precedence metadata but has no versioned schema adapters, stable claim keys, assertion ledger, or conflict graph.

stable_keys: exact project identifier plus enumerated claim dimension
minimal_deterministic_fix.assertion_rule: Preserve every candidate assertion, provenance record, control status, and verification status; emit unresolved when incompatible candidates share a stable key.
minimal_deterministic_fix.insufficient_schema_rule: If semantic meaning exists only in free prose, request an explicit assertion_code or structured supplement rather than inferring truth.
minimal_deterministic_fix.question_contract: Stable question IDs derive from the versioned rule and stable claim key, never file order or row count.

forbidden_automation: Do not resolve a conflict by source class, recency, signature, approval, or filename.
Do not use fuzzy entity matching or unrestricted prose NLP to assert a fact.
Do not convert evidence_excerpt into accepted truth.
Do not close a conflict until the relevant claim key receives an explicit human decision or verified structured supplement.

include: its candidate assertions and conflict status
readiness gates explicitly mapped to that claim key

planned_tests: Stable conflicts are produced for P2601, P2602, P2603, forecast, ownership, IP, and licence fixtures.
Conflict and question IDs remain identical when files and rows are reordered.
No conflict is fabricated when a stable key or explicit assertion semantics are absent.
Human acceptance updates only the matching claim key and mapped readiness gates.

verified_defects.title: Generic as_of_date falsely triggers financial preflight for non-financial CSVs

observed_evidence.initial_detected_artifacts: all seven CSV payloads, artifact IDs 0002 through 0008
observed_evidence.trigger: generic as_of_date and other basis-like metadata are sufficient to create a basis record

locations.finding: Returns a basis record when any one generic metadata field, including as_of_date, is present.
Calls _basis_record for every row regardless of document type and sets detected from the resulting records.
The recognized cash and forecast schemas are narrow in inconsistent ways: generic metadata over-detects files while version aliasing under-detects the real plans.

minimal_deterministic_fix.rule: Parseability and control metadata do not imply financial applicability; require a complete recognized financial schema archetype.
minimal_deterministic_fix.as_of_rule: as_of_date alone, or with version/approval/signature metadata, never makes a file financially applicable.
recognized_archetypes: P&L with explicit line item, numeric value, period, currency/unit
sales ledger with explicit transaction and amount fields
treasury with account/balance and restriction or availability fields
forecast with financial metric columns, period, version, and control metadata
minimal_deterministic_fix.expected_round_3_result: Only the two board-plan files are forecast candidates; management, counterparty, corporate-register, and provenance CSVs are not financial artifacts solely because they contain as_of_date.
minimal_deterministic_fix.cash_rule: The management Available cash 4.4 claim remains an unverified claim, not a treasury basis candidate, until account/entity/restriction evidence is supplied.

forbidden_automation: Do not infer a financial schema from generic dates or control metadata.
Do not convert a management cash claim into available cash without account-level restriction evidence.
Do not run calculations merely because a financial-looking column exists.
Do not auto-select a forecast version after it becomes detectable.
planned_tests: A non-financial CSV containing as_of_date, version, approval, and signature metadata is not applicable.
Round 3 non-board CSVs alone do not trigger financial preflight.
The full Round 3 pack detects only the two board plans as forecast candidates.
Both version and forecast_version are supported only within a recognized forecast schema.
Available cash 4.4 without account and restriction fields is not a treasury basis candidate.
Existing supported Round 2 financial fixtures remain green.

global_forbidden_boundaries: No automatic repair or trust of a mismatched declaration.
No evidence credit for missing underlying payloads or quarantined indexes.
No valuation, rating, runway, or public conclusion before human acceptance and ready gates.

implementation_sequence.work: Implement exact manifest reconciliation and quarantine propagation.
implementation_sequence.reason: The integrity status of 07 controls whether its provenance assertions may be used.

implementation_sequence.work: Tighten financial applicability and add controlled version alias support for recognized forecasts.
implementation_sequence.reason: This removes the broad false positive while restoring the two actual forecast candidates.

implementation_sequence.work: Add independent document-control candidates with human-only selection.
implementation_sequence.reason: Version, recency, approval, effectiveness, signature, authority, and verification must remain distinct.

implementation_sequence.work: Add actual-payload and declared-underlying duplicate layers.
implementation_sequence.reason: Counting and provenance require different trust rules.

implementation_sequence.work: Add explicit-schema claim adapters, stable conflict IDs, and dependency-scoped recompute.
implementation_sequence.reason: Conflicts can be surfaced safely only after identity, integrity, and control metadata are reliable.

completion_criteria_for_future_fix: The exact 07 hash mismatch is visible and blocking.
Only recognized financial schemas trigger financial preflight.
Both board-plan versions are visible with independent controls and no automatic selection.
Duplicate aliases are retained while accepted evidence counts are content-addressed.
Cross-file conflicts are stable, unresolved by default, and locally recomputable.
No product calculation, valuation, rating, or release occurs from unaccepted evidence.
